master_original_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create an original mascot character concept for Kairos, a personal AI companion for everyday work and life. One distinctive, intelligent, warm little companion with a compact rounded silhouette, expressive attentive eyes, and a subtle time-inspired detail integrated naturally into its design. It should feel calm, capable, curious and approachable, with memorable simple forms that remain recognizable as a small avatar. Premium stylized 3D illustration with tactile matte materials, restrained harmonious colors chosen to suit the character, soft studio lighting, careful beautiful craft. Single character, full body, gentle three-quarter view, centered on a clean uncluttered light background, generous margin, square composition. This is a character portrait concept, not a presentation board. No text, no labels, no watermark, no additional characters, no complex scenery. Avoid generic stock robot styling or excessive mechanical detail.

derivatives.name: kairos-cutout
derivatives.brief: Use case: background-extraction. Remove only the background of the supplied master portrait. Preserve the exact pose, character details, silhouette, face and colors. One complete full-body character with comfortable transparent margin. Genuine alpha transparency, no checkerboard pixels, no ground plane, no cast background shadow. Do not redesign or invent details.

Premium soft stylized 3D render with gentle studio light and warm restrained materials; accurately preserve head-body proportions and construction from reference.

derivatives.name: kairos-turnaround
derivatives.brief: Use case: identity-preserve. Create a clean professional character turnaround reference sheet on warm white, wide landscape layout, FOUR evenly spaced full-body views of the SAME approved character: straight front, left profile, straight back, three-quarter view matching original. Same scale and ground line, all silhouettes separate and uncropped. Neutral pose. Keep head ornament structurally attached to curved hood tip in every view, same side flaps and scarf/watch. Back view naturally omits face and front watch, show plain cream back of hood and scarf knot; do not invent a tail. No text, arrows, decorations or frames. This is a drawing reference, not four new characters.

derivatives.name: kairos-expressions
derivatives.brief: Use case: identity-preserve. Create a 3 by 2 clean expression reference sheet, SIX evenly separated head-and-shoulder portraits of the exact same character on warm white. Keep full hood-tip orbital ornament, drooping side flaps, scarf and watch visible in every cell and leave generous gutters. Reading left-to-right top row: attentive neutral gentle smile; thinking with slight head tilt and one raised brow; delighted with happy crescent eyes and modest open smile. Bottom row: curious with widened eyes and little surprised mouth; concerned/apologetic with gently angled eyebrows and restrained expression; sleepy with relaxed closed eyelids and peaceful small smile. Change only expressions and subtle head tilt, no extra symbols, tears, accessories or redesign. Same scale and camera angle, no labels.
